contract.description: Fetch clusters of old, similar journal entries due for distillation into durable facts - each group carries its entry records, similarity and the stalest access time, and the whole backlog counts as memory_stats pendingCompaction. Run the loop deliberately: write one kind=Fact memory_remember per group, then memory_forget each consumed entry; distill within one tome at a time.
contract.name: memory_compact_candidates
contract.title: Get compaction candidates
